name: web_fetch_result
description: Compact HTTP fetch outcome card — status, document title, URL, content type, size, and elapsed time. The response body is intentionally not carried in the widget; it stays in the tool result text.

final_url.description: Post-redirect URL, when it differs from the requested URL.

content_type.description: Bare media type from the Content-Type header.

truncated.description: True when the body was capped before reaching the model.

title.description: Document title, extracted for HTML responses.
